name: voidbicho
description: The compute layer for Void Core: how an application acquires a model, runs it, pays for it, and tells the truth about what it did. A model is a rune; selection is a tag query; every invocation returns a provenance stamp. Perception models (segmentation, 3D lifting, captioning, embedding) optionally enrich a host's log.
status_note: First code 2026-10-10: a Python perception runtime (python/bicho/: catalogue, tag-query selection, the invocation contract, SAM 2.1 Large and OpenCLIP adapters, a JSON-lines serve mode), driven by Void Squid's toolbox as a process. Weights live in %USERPROFILE%/.voidbicho/models, never in the repository; CUDA PyTorch in a git-ignored .venv. Nothing links Bicho, so requires is empty. third_party/ holds SAM 3D Objects as a reference only. ONNX Runtime and Needle's C++ engine remain planned (okf/roadmap.md).
kind_note: A library with no user-facing install, hence `runtime`; the schema has no `library` kind.

interacts_with.name: voidsquid
interacts_with.note: Planned. Void Squid's smart logs (layer 3, learned perception) and its asset library would invoke Bicho models through Void Core's `effect` seam; no link either way.

interacts_with.name: voidmago
interacts_with.note: Reads this manifest to build the family compatibility matrix.

provides.effects_note: None yet. When built, every model invocation is an effect by Bicho's own contract (okf/concepts/invocation.md).

vendors.name: SAM 3D Objects
vendors.note: Reference code only: not compiled, not linked, no weights. Needs Linux and a 32 GB GPU. See third_party/README.md.
